source.name: Footy Headlines – Adidas Al Qadsiah 26-27 Home & Away Kits Released – No More Nike
source.quote: Saudi Pro League club Al Qadsiah has officially unveiled its new 2026-27 home and away kits, marking the beginning of their new partnership with adidas after switching from previous supplier Nike.
source.note: The article's home-kit photo shows the NOVA logo on the red home shorts, above the club crest. The club store's home-shorts product page (store.alqadsiah.com, Arabic product name: 'Al Qadsiah home shorts for adults - adidas') shows the shorts with the crest only, without sponsor prints, so the NOVA logo is confirmed from the kit-reveal photo.

source.name: Al Qadsiah FC – Al-Qadsiah Signs with Adidas as Official Kit Partner
source.quote: Al-Qadsiah FC has announced the signing of a partnership with global brand Adidas, under which the sportswear giant will provide match and training kit
source.note: Club announcement; the page is dated Friday 12 June 2026 and states the partnership covers the Men's, Women's and Academy teams from 1 July 2026. Footy Headlines (2026-06-23, https://www.footyheadlines.com/4897334798/adidas-al-qadsiah-26-27-home-away-kits-released-no-more-nike.html) reported the kit reveal and the switch from previous supplier Nike. The page loads its text with JavaScript, so a script can't check the quote.

summary: adidas home kit. Front: Aloula Aviation (main), SRACO, Genesis, BESTE (BesteBit). Back: IZ by Alinma, ZOHO, SIXT. Sleeve: Dar wa Emaar. Shorts: NOVA (Batook). Shirt placements confirmed against the club store's product photos of the 2026/27 home shirt; NOVA on the shorts from Footy Headlines' home-kit photo, as the club store's shorts photo shows only the crest. The only other print, above the IZ lockup, is the club's own motto 'من الخبر إلى العالم / From Khobar to the World', not a sponsor.
